title: focus.json
description: The current mood: a visual operating state, not just a notification switch. `neutral` is the resting state; the other five each carry their own accent role, surface alpha, density, motion energy and notification policy (see Focus.qml's `moods` table — not duplicated here, same as theme.json naming a palette rather than embedding one). Also the firm-focus contract: read by the media browser and game launchers (refuse-to-start, with a reason) and by do-not-disturb; never by anything that would kill an already-running session.

mode.description: The active mood. `neutral` is the default, unrestricted state; every other mood blocks the launches enforce.md lists (except launching into itself) until `until`, or forever if `until` is null.

until.description: ISO-8601 timestamp the mood lapses back to `neutral` at, or null for an open-ended session that only an explicit `stop`/`set` ends.
